verdict.rationale: 1Password ships automation surfaces such as Service Accounts, Connect, the CLI and SDKs, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows a way to version, review, or roll back those automations. The only versioning evidence is the Events API's URL-path and spec versioning (V1/V2 endpoints, changelog), which concerns the vendor's own API rather than user automations, so it does not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
